question: 请查询2026年5月各型号售出30天激活率情况
sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT
    b.device_id,
    d.product_id,
    o.paid_date
  FROM bridge_order_device AS b
  JOIN fact_order_item AS i ON b.item_id = i.item_id
  JOIN fact_order AS o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN dim_device AS d ON b.device_id = d.device_id
  WHERE o.paid_date <= CAST('2026-10-16' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30' DAY
    AND DATE_FORMAT(o.paid_date, '%Y-%m') = '2026-05'
),
outcomes AS (
  SELECT
    c.device_id
  FROM cohort AS c
  JOIN fact_device_activation AS e ON c.device_id = e.device_id
  WHERE e.activation_date BETWEEN c.paid_date AND c.paid_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY
)
SELECT
  p.product_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.device_id) AS devices,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.device_id) AS matched_devices,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT e.device_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.device_id), 0), 2) AS rate_percent
FROM cohort AS c
JOIN dim_product AS p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN outcomes AS e ON c.device_id = e.device_id
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY rate_percent DESC
